Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side), PDF page 10: the slip of [[LE-BO2D9 (Leebo) (V) (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014). It prints errata version PC-E3 (“May be battled. If with Dash Rendar, adds one destiny to attrition only. Once per turn, if at a battleground, you may peek at top card of opponent's Reserve Deck; may place that card on top of opponent's Used Pile.”), word for word the text of [[LE-BO2D9 (Leebo) (V)]].<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Master List (Light Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
